* HTTPS decryption: Hodor can decrypt HTTPS requests, allowing you to easily view and modify HTTPS requests and responses.

* Real-time modification of requests and responses: Hodor can modify requests and responses in real-time, helping you better understand the relationship between requests and responses.
* Mock requests and responses: Hodor can simulate requests and responses, making it convenient for you to test and debug.
